thread:
maya: Quick pulse — want to run a short 3-post series across X + LinkedIn next week to push webinar signups. Need final assets + copy + tracking UTMs by EOD Wed. Plan = teaser (Mon), deep-dive invite (Wed), last-chance reminder (Thu).

sam: SG. Who owns the hero image? dims?

maya: I'll own hero. hero dims: 1200x627 for LinkedIn, 1200x675 (16:9) for X cards; thumbnail 800x800. I'll drop originals in the drive folder: `/Marketing/Campaigns/dawn-series/assets`.

toni: I'll draft copy — doing 2 variants per platform (technical vs. product-friendly). Any hard claims we should avoid?

alex: Avoid exact benchmark numbers until we get legal signoff. Use phrasing like "significant latency & cost improvements" for public posts. We can include exact numbers in the webinar landing page after approval.

maya: noted. Primary narrative: predictable latency, cost-control levers, unified runtime across deployments. CTA: "Register — limited seats".

jamie: Inbound routing — can we tag signups with `utm_source=social&utm_campaign=dawn_series` and `utm_content` per post (teaser|deep|reminder) so SDRs can prioritize? Want them funneled to queue `webinar-spark`.

maya: yes. Use `utm_medium=social` too. @social-bot can you provision short links and confirm tracking?

social-bot: Created tracking links and short URLs:
- teaser: https://rwd.link/dawn1
- deep-dive: https://rwd.link/dawn2
- reminder: https://rwd.link/dawn3
All links include `utm_source=social&utm_campaign=dawn_series&utm_medium=social` and an `utm_content` param we can swap per post.

sam: Great. For scheduling, propose times: LinkedIn posts at 11am PT, X posts at 9am PT (teaser), deep-dive at 10am PT, reminder at 2pm PT. Thoughts?

toni: 11am PT is good for LinkedIn. For X, earlier (9am) tends to get more impressions. I'll tailor first lines per platform.

maya: Asset list needed ASAP: 30s highlight clip (mp4), hero image (two aspect ratios), 3 static carousel images for LI, slide-deck PDF for landing page, short bios for hosts. Can the design team deliver by Wed noon?

sam: I'll ping design — tagging @design. If we need to reduce scope, can we drop carousel and do single image + clip?

maya: Prefer to keep carousel but okay to fallback to single image + clip if design bandwidth is tight.

alex: Partners — are we tagging any external partners or authors in the posts? That can bump reach.

maya: We're planning to tag @OpenModelCo and @BenchmarkHQ for the deep-dive. Confirm with partners before we post.

toni: Draft copies posted below, feel free to iterate. Variant A (technical):
```
Teaser (LI): "Curious how teams get stable sub-100ms inference at scale? Join our webinar to see the runtime and routing tricks that cut cost and keep latency predictable. Register: <short link>"
```
Variant B (product):
```
Teaser (LI): "Ship smarter, serve faster. Join our webinar to learn how to make LLM inference predictable and economical — from hosted to on-prem. Save your seat: <short link>"
```

maya: nice starts. Change "sub-100ms" to "sub-100ms (typical)" only if legal signs off. For now keep the product variant for public posts.

sam: Quick ask on reactions/engage flow — want an after-post-thread runbook: 1) thank commenters within 2 hours, 2) amplify top comments via clip highlight, 3) route inbound questions to #support-ask. Can ops agree?

jamie: SDR flow confirmed. We'll tag leads with `lead_source=social_dawn` and push to `webinar-spark` queue. Follow-ups done by SDRs within 24h.

maya: Also want to run a tiny paid boost on the deep-dive post targeted to developer job titles in NA/EMEA. Budget ask ~ $500. @finance ok?

alex: Approve $500 from social budget. Please send final copy + assets to me for a quick compliance scan before scheduling.

maya: will do. Final checklist before Wed EOD: assets in drive, final copy per platform, UTMs set, short links confirmed, partner tags approved, paid boost creative + budget form filled.

sam: I'll slot the posts in the scheduler once assets are up.

social-bot: Scheduler draft created: posts queued for 2026-04-06 11:00 PT (LI teaser), 2026-04-08 10:00 PT (deep-dive), 2026-04-09 14:00 PT (reminder). API draft IDs: 7891, 7892, 7893.

toni: Small ask — can we also get a 30s captionless clip for paid creative? That performs better as a muted ad.

maya: yes will request that from video.

sam: perfect. tagging this thread as the canonical planning convo. I'll post a follow-up with final published URLs and SOV metrics after the campaign. :rocket:
